headline: Visa expands Agentic Ready program to merchants, with PayPal, Adyen and Stripe joining
body: Visa is expanding its Agentic Ready program to the merchant acceptance ecosystem, adding partners including PayPal, Adyen and Fiserv. The program is kicking off with 140-plus participants, Visa said, with more financial institutions, merchants and enablers expected to join throughout next year.
note: Card networks are moving agent payments from announcements to shared testing with the firms that process the transactions. Banks and acquirers will want to see how the tests recognize agent-initiated payments.

evidence.text: Visa is expanding its Agentic Ready program to the merchant acceptance ecosystem, adding several new partners including PayPal , Adyen and Fiserv .
The program is kicking off with 140-plus participants, with more financial institutions, merchants and enablers expected to join throughout next year, Visa said.
Other companies joining the program with this latest expansion include Antom , Billtrust , Checkout.com , Global Payments , and Stripe , the release said.
